newEntriesNeeded.title: ONERROR GOLABEL error transfer command
newEntriesNeeded.principle: ONERROR GOLABEL redirects macro execution to a labeled handler on error
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Use ONERROR GOLABEL /Label at the top of a macro to enable centralized error handling
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- ONERROR GOLABEL /Error
-- ... macro steps ...
LABEL /Error
handle any
  SAVEWORK
  UNCLAIM ALL
  -- error logging
endhandle
pitfalls: GOLABEL target must be a LABEL statement, not a label reference

newEntriesNeeded.title: UNCLAIM ALL PML command
newEntriesNeeded.principle: UNCLAIM ALL releases all claimed elements in error handlers
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Always call UNCLAIM ALL in error handlers to prevent element lock conflicts
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
handle any
  SAVEWORK
  UNCLAIM ALL
endhandle
pitfalls: UNCLAIM ALL releases ALL claims, including those from other macros

newEntriesNeeded.title: unset() and badref() dbref validation
newEntriesNeeded.principle: Check dbref validity with unset() and badref() before accessing attributes
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Use (unset(:dbref) or badref(:dbref)) as guard before attribute access
newEntriesNeeded.syntax:
if (unset(:dbref) or badref(:dbref)) then
  -- handle
endif
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
if (unset(:TagRefToClass) or badref(:TagRefToClass)) then
  return
endif
!val = :TagRefToClass:AttributeName
pitfalls: badref() returns true for references pointing to deleted elements
unset() returns true for null references

newEntriesNeeded.title: inset operator for array membership check
newEntriesNeeded.principle: inset checks if a value is a member of an array literal
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Use value inset ('A', 'B', 'C') to check membership against a list
pitfalls: array literal must use single quotes

newEntriesNeeded.title: ISNAMED dbref keyword
newEntriesNeeded.principle: ISNAMED checks if a dbref is named (has a NAME attribute)
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Use ISNAMED in dbref expressions to filter named elements only
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
if (ISNAMED and :TagName neq NAMN) then
  -- update
endif
pitfalls: ISNAMED cannot be used alone outside a dbref expression context

newEntriesNeeded.title: Attribute query with of operator
newEntriesNeeded.principle: The of operator queries an attribute on a dbref in expressions
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Use :AttributeName of :dbref to access an attribute value in expressions
pitfalls: Attribute must exist on the dbref type

newEntriesNeeded.title: STRING.String(FORMAT) with I2 zero-padding
newEntriesNeeded.principle: Use STRING.String(REAL, FORMAT) to format numbers with fixed-width zero-padding
pitfalls: I2 requires the value to be a REAL or INTEGER

newEntriesNeeded.title: Macro-level error handler with ONERROR + handle any
newEntriesNeeded.principle: Combine ONERROR GOLABEL at macro start with handle any block for centralized error recovery
newEntriesNeeded.rule: Place ONERROR GOLABEL /Error at top, LABEL /Error at bottom with handle any block
newEntriesNeeded.syntax:
ONERROR GOLABEL /Error
-- steps...
LABEL /Error
handle any
  SAVEWORK
  UNCLAIM ALL
endhandle
newEntriesNeeded.exampleCanonical:
-- ONERROR GOLABEL /Error
$P --- STEP 1 ---
$P --- STEP 2 ---
LABEL /Error
handle any
  SAVEWORK
  UNCLAIM ALL
endhandle
newEntriesNeeded.exampleAntipattern:
handle any
  -- no ONERROR GOLABEL, only catches inline errors
endhandle
pitfalls: ONERROR only triggers at macro level, not within handle blocks
handle any catches all errors including those in nested calls
